title: Acceptance and the offered share
hook: Two stated cases: explore the assumed response probability with a fixed offer.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the assumed response probability with a fixed offer affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the assumed response probability with a fixed offer in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
